telos.statement: Determine whether a large class of Decision Lab's current journey problems are manifestations of one mechanism, the Instrument-Telos Gap, in which the product asks the player to incur cost whose primary beneficiary is the measurement system, or whether they are better explained by competing hypotheses that were frozen before the audit: UX legibility, time-to-value, the unreachable learning layer, dual-ontology leakage, market mismatch, or no structural problem at all.
telos.success_condition: The audit discriminates rather than confirms. The answer names which hypothesis the measured evidence supports, names at least one FIELD observation that would weaken the owner's own hypothesis, and does not credit that hypothesis for costs that a feature flag, better wording, or an earlier payoff would cover.

current_state.summary: Decision Lab records a chess decision BEFORE the engine answers. A frozen product-state walk of the shipped bundle established what is reachable. The core loop pays every time: place a move, submit, and the reveal returns what the move cost, what the record cannot support, and a question. Three instruments sit on top of that loop. Confidence is asked always on first/anchor/drill/transfer and at ASK_RATE=0.15 on ordinary play; it is the only source of the calibration gap and nothing an engine can produce afterwards substitutes for it. The two read fields are coupled to the same draw and are consumed immediately: shared/reveal.ts nextQuestion anchors the reveal's question to the player's own stated unknown, which the file calls the one thing on screen the engine did not produce. The counterfactual probe fires on 35 percent of eligible decisions; its immediate payoff, the named alternative scored beside the played move, exists but sits behind a disclosure, and its full four-way reading needs 30 probed decisions. Two measured walks of the built bundle at 390x844: six decisions cost 34 taps and four decisions cost 26 taps, and in both the discovery counter ended at 1 of 60, because first is refused by discovery and only one play decision drew the confidence question. The product states the floor twice in plain words and states that even at 60 the result would be a hypothesis and not a finding; it never states the conversion rate between decisions taken and decisions counted. The record page shows two denominators from two populations, 60 counted decisions and 30 blitz games, with nothing saying they are two. A blitz game writes nothing to the record until it finishes. The whole Evidence to Learning to Transfer half is unreachable because EXPERIMENTAL_LEARNING_ENABLED is off, a decision recorded in D25. The audit artefacts available to this run are: a frozen seven-hypothesis plan with a discrimination table fixed before the evidence; an action-value ledger over sixteen reachable costly actions with eight permitted verdicts, built by walking the built bundle; a counterfactual delete audit; a value-debt map over seven journey paths; an internal-ontology leakage classification; an instrumentation burden audit; a value-repayment map; a telos chain; a founder-translation audit; and a frozen FIELD protocol with measures M1 to M8, assistance levels A0 to A3 and interpretation rules fixed before any participant.

diagnosis.material_question: Is the Instrument-Telos Gap a real root mechanism in Decision Lab, a local effect confined to the three instruments layered on the core loop, or an artefact of a lens elastic enough to absorb any friction; and if real, where does the single highest-value intervention sit given that the core loop already repays every decision immediately?
diagnosis.bottleneck: The lens has no recorded refusal. Every measured cost so far cited in its support — the 8-tap instrumented decision against the 3-to-4-tap uninstrumented one, the discovery counter ending at 1 of 60 after six decisions, the two denominators from two populations — is also fully consistent with three hypotheses frozen before the audit: H4 (the flag makes the Evidence-to-Learning-to-Transfer half unreachable, so instrument cost has no visible terminus), H2 (the conversion rate between decisions taken and decisions counted is never stated anywhere in the product), and H3 (distance to the accumulation threshold of 30 and 60). Until each uncovered cost is tested against a lens that can decline to apply, the audit confirms rather than discriminates, and the success condition is unmet by construction. Compounding this, all nine context_refs failed delivery, so the frozen discrimination table, the sixteen-action ledger verdicts and the delete audit — the only artefacts that record what the lens already refused — are not in hand for this diagnosis.

diagnosis.rationale: The telos is discrimination, not confirmation, so the miscalibration to fix is in the lens rather than in the product. Three of the costs currently cited for the Instrument-Telos Gap are each separately covered by a hypothesis frozen before the audit — the unreachable learning half by the flag, the never-stated conversion between decisions taken and decisions counted by wording, and the 30-and-60 thresholds by distance to payoff — which is precisely the reversal condition already written into this task. The cheapest decision-changing learning is therefore not a new observation at all: it is recovering the nine undelivered artefacts, since the frozen discrimination table and the ledger's eight permitted verdicts record where the lens has already declined to apply, and the repository has demonstrably run this mission's own delete test on itself by cutting the read fields from every decision to a sample and writing down that six decisions in seven bought nothing measurable. That is evidence of a lens that refuses, and it is held in REPO, not in FIELD. Only after subtracting the covered costs is it worth paying NETA, whose band this squarely is — tap count is a proxy for instrument-serving burden, the discovery counter is a proxy for progress, and the 500/5000 simulated games are a proxy for player tolerance that the repository itself marks as judgement rather than measurement. OWNER is deferred deliberately: an owner ruling on the owner's own hypothesis, taken before the residue is named, would contaminate the discrimination the success condition demands, and owner agreement would not constitute triangulation in any case. FIELD stays the eventual discriminator because zero humans have used the audited build and M6 and M7 are the only measures that separate the mechanism from time-to-value and market pull, but it is already the default path and its protocol is frozen; the value of this diagnosis is to fix which residue the run is testing so its result reads as discrimination. No move proposed here touches the flag, the frozen stimulus at 4c39563, the unmerged lanes, the sampling rates, or the evidence policy's refusal of drill, transfer, import, anchor and first from discovery. The expected deltas above are ex-ante commitments about which decision-state dimensions each resource could still move if invoked now; RND and NETA are marked evidence-false because neither produces a new observation, and OWNER is marked reversal-false because the reversal condition is evidence-shaped and authority cannot satisfy it.

result.summary: RAW SIGNAL preserved: "the product asks the player to incur cost whose primary beneficiary is the measurement system." On the evidence actually present in this request, that mechanism is not supported as a global root cause, is contradicted in the per-decision region, and is under-discriminated in the accumulation region. Three separate observations are being bundled under one lens and they do not share a mechanism. (1) The confidence draw is scored as having an immediate differentiated payoff — shared/reveal.ts nextQuestion consumes statedUnknown on the very next screen — and the repository has already run this mission's delete test on itself, cutting the field from required to sampled with the reason recorded. An instrument that feeds the next screen and that has already survived a self-administered delete test is the lens's own strongest predicted case, and it fails the prediction. (2) The counterfactual probe has a payoff that exists but sits behind a disclosure. That is a salience and progressive-disclosure problem, not a beneficiary problem; rendered is not noticed, and the ledger's AVAILABLE_NOW verdict cannot distinguish the two. (3) The record page's two denominators from two populations cost the player nothing to render.
